project.name: niuse
project.title: niuse
project.summary: A personal engineering companion on top of niucode: seven Markdown stores for identity, memory, and human goals, an opt-in shared TUI, project context, and a long-horizon roadmap. The board records architecture, decisions, and iteration; it is not runtime monitoring.
project.status: M2/M5 gates · M3/M6/M7/M8 done · M10 web

milestones.title: Bootstrap
milestones.goal: Ship the smallest runnable loop for identity and memory.
exit: five stores with atomic 0600 writes
in-band protocol works end to end
the REPL completes one real turn

milestones.title: Memory loop
milestones.goal: Make memory trustworthy: confirmation, conflicts, expiry, privacy, and cold start.
exit: bootstrap → review → memory works end to end
a secret match is refused
per-turn cwd on one session

milestones.title: Dogfood
milestones.goal: Prove with real work that it remembers, is reliable, and dares to disagree, instead of adding features.
exit: ten consecutive working days, at least one real task per day through niuse
candidate acceptance rate ≥ 60%
at least once it disagrees and you change your mind

milestones.title: Distribution
milestones.goal: Make the project installable, publishable, and maintainable.
exit: the niucode dependency is versioned, or git install is the stated path
cargo package and installation are reproducible
name, license, and release channels are settled

milestones.title: Shared front end
milestones.goal: Stop maintaining a second front end: reuse niucode's TUI and loop behind a library and a small hook surface.
exit: niucode-cli exports a library plus turn hooks
niuse deletes its renderer and runs the shared TUI
the product-only layer stays below roughly 1k lines

milestones.title: Harness-native companion
milestones.goal: Make the existing niucode harness the companion's default working surface instead of a parallel front end.
exit: TUI approval and usage parity with the REPL contract
ten real TUI dogfood days are recorded
the renderer is retired only after that gate

milestones.title: Compounding context
milestones.goal: Make what the companion knows visible and useful at the moment work starts, without adding a database.
exit: startup brief surfaces overdue promises and review queues
project registry answers where the work was
session digest and on-demand recall are proven in real use

milestones.title: Long-horizon work
milestones.goal: Let one request become a checked sequence of work that survives a session boundary.
exit: persistent product goals survive resume
plan → execute → verify records evidence for each step
a three-day goal completes without re-explaining the task

milestones.title: Connected agent
milestones.goal: Reach personal tools and data through a standard, trust-bounded connector.
exit: niucode ships a stdio MCP client with trust and timeouts
niuse ships one personal pack behind least privilege
a connector cannot escape its declared roots

milestones.title: Proof
milestones.goal: Measure whether the companion is actually more useful, and keep it that way.
exit: offline personal-agent suite covers recall, briefs, goals, and delegation
memory-on/off A/B shows a behavioural difference
dogfood regressions block a release

milestones.title: Web companion
milestones.goal: 把 niuse 的产品上下文和交互带到本地浏览器，同时复用 niucode 的传输、审批和渲染。
exit: niuse web 使用七类 store 组合出产品 prompt，并绑定本地 thread
身份、用户、记忆、计划在浏览器可见
复用 niucode 的 SSE、审批、Markdown 和 MathML
只绑定 127.0.0.1，无远程认证面

modules.title: CLI
modules.summary: Clap entry, subcommand dispatch, offline commands, and bootstrap / review wiring.
modules.contract: Parse flags and dispatch; offline commands never construct a provider; only agent commands resolve credentials.
notes: Bare niuse starts the REPL.
mem / loops / journal / identity / status work offline.
sandbox / approval / network keep niucode's semantics.

modules.title: REPL
modules.summary: Interactive conversation, slash commands, candidate confirmation, editing, and streaming render.
modules.contract: Build one AgentConfig per turn; call run_with_history only through the driver; memory writes always happen after confirmation.
notes: The tail buffer keeps protocol blocks from leaking to the user.
At most one candidate per turn; after a rejection the session stops proposing.
Ctrl-C cancels the current turn; Ctrl-D exits.
The system prompt is assembled once per session.

modules.title: Shared front end
modules.summary: Reuse niucode's TUI and runtime through a library target plus turn hooks; retire niuse's renderer.
modules.contract: niucode-cli exposes a library and hooks for prompt augmentation, turn-end observation, and session lifecycle; niuse implements them.
notes: ADR-0032 accepted; library target and TurnHooks exported in niucode aac20a1.
Hooks are not yet invoked; niuse still owns the renderer.
The hook surface must stay generic; memory policy remains in niuse.

modules.title: Prompt
modules.summary: Stable-prefix system prompt assembly with per-section budget trimming.
modules.contract: Takes the five stores and a date, returns a Composition; reads no disk, calls no model, writes no state.
notes: Fixed order: persona → identity → user → memory → protocol → today → loops → journal.
Expired memory is not injected; entries older than 30 days carry an unverified label.
About 4k tokens; over budget, drop the oldest unverified facts first.

modules.title: Protocol
modules.summary: Parsing and streaming-aware stripping of the in-band memory / loop / journal blocks.
modules.contract: StreamFilter releases only safe text; parse returns visible + blocks; no storage access.
notes: No extra model call.
An unterminated block is shown as ordinary text instead of silently eaten.
journal and loop are written automatically; memory requires confirmation.

modules.title: Policy
modules.summary: Soft expiry, conflict similarity, and secret-pattern scanning.
modules.contract: Pure functions; refusal is the default, and overriding requires an explicit --force.
notes: Character-bigram Jaccard works for both Chinese and English.
Sharing a tag lowers the threshold to 0.35.
The secret scan is a backstop, not a guarantee.

modules.title: Driver
modules.summary: The niucode boundary: open and resume sessions, project history, per-turn cwd, forward events.
modules.contract: Only this file imports niucode-agent; target about 200 lines; do not change the loop or fork it.
notes: Per-turn working_dir on one session is verified.
History is projected by project_history from the event log; there is no second transcript.
Ctrl-C cancels provider and tools by dropping the future.

modules.title: Bootstrap
modules.summary: Mine old niucode sessions into an inbox, then review candidates one by one.
modules.contract: Send only user / assistant text; one tool-free call per session; never write memory directly.
notes: Tool output is dropped before extraction.
Only sessions with dialogue are kept, to avoid wasting model calls.
Candidates are deduplicated against existing memory and within the batch.

modules.title: Stores
modules.summary: Parse and atomically save the five stores with 0700 / 0600, merging journal entries by day.
modules.contract: Markdown is the only format; write a temporary file then rename; reads tolerate bad lines.
notes: A missing identity.md is a legal state, not an empty string.
Memory is split into preferences.md / lessons.md.
Dates are UTC-based to avoid a timezone database.

modules.title: Dashboard
modules.summary: A single-file offline board: Architecture / Work / Docs / Decisions.
modules.contract: Generate from project.json, board/*.md, and docs/**/*.md; --check fails when output is stale.
notes: Generated artifacts are docs/index.html and docs/dashboard/model.json.
Architecture is the first screen.
The board is read-only; state changes go through the repository.

events.title: Position niuse as cross-project engineering memory
events.detail: Not a general agent, not a second brain. Only preferences, decisions, and pitfalls; project knowledge stays in AGENTS.md.

events.title: Keep the identity layer separate from memory
events.detail: identity is human-written and the agent may only propose; journal and loops are automatic; memory requires confirmation. What persists is the identity, not a process.

events.title: Emit protocol blocks in-band from the main model
events.detail: No extra model call. Missing a memory is acceptable; recording a wrong one is not. Streaming needs a tail buffer.

events.title: MVP implemented
events.detail: Five stores, prompt, protocol, REPL, driver, and bootstrap landed; the offline test suite passes.

events.title: Reuse niucode's architecture-first board
events.detail: Same xtask generator and three-column shell, with a niuse project model. The board records architecture and implementation, not runtime monitoring.

events.title: Keep two repos and move the front end upstream
events.detail: niucode owns the kernel, TUI, and hooks; niuse owns identity, memory, policy, and defaults. Merge only if the product layer becomes thin enough that separate releases stop mattering.

events.title: Grow from memory layer to working companion
events.detail: niuse adds project context, briefs, goals, and delegation while generic capability lands in niucode first. No daemon, no second store; every phase exits on real use.

events.title: Give human goals their own store
events.detail: goals.md is human-owned, injected after user and before memory, and capped at seven open goals; loops remain the companion's promises.

events.title: Keep thread.jsonl as the only active line
events.detail: TUI /resume and /fork switch the live session and notify hooks, but do not change the next launch. No pointer file, no archive promotion; /new and /reset are the only cross-restart switches.
